sections.title: Green Horizon Eco-Tours Booking
sections.context: A customer is calling a travel agency to book a specialized eco-tour for his family.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Good morning! Green Horizon Eco-Tours, this is Sarah speaking. How can I assist you today?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Hello Sarah, I’m calling because I saw your advertisement in the Sunday Travel Magazine. I’m interested in booking the 'Amazon Rainforest Adventure' for my family this coming summer.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: That’s a fantastic choice! It’s one of our most popular tours. Before we check the availability, I'll need to take down some of your details. Could I start with your full name, please?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Yes, it’s Mark Henderson.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Henderson. And a contact number where we can reach you?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Sure. It's 0412 555 892... actually, wait, that’s my old work number. My current mobile is 0412 555 982.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Got it. 0412 555 982. Now, which month were you planning to travel? We have departures in July and August.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: We were hoping for the 14th of July if that’s still open.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Let me check the system... Oh, I'm sorry. The 14th is fully booked. However, we do have spaces left on the 18th of July. Would that work for you?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: The 18th? Let me see... yes, that should be fine. We don't have to be back until the end of the month anyway.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Excellent. This specific tour lasts for 5 days. It covers the deep jungle exploration and a visit to the macaw sanctuary. How many people will be joining you?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: There will be four of us. My wife, myself, and our two teenage children.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Perfect. And does anyone in your group have any special dietary requirements? Our jungle lodges need to know in advance.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: My wife is a vegetarian. The rest of us eat anything, but please make sure there's a meat-free option for her.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: No problem at all. I've noted that down. Now, regarding the logistics, the tour package includes a shuttle service. Where will you be staying before the tour starts?

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: We’ll be at the Central Hotel. Is that a possible pick-up point?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Yes, the Central Hotel is on our main route. The shuttle will be there at 7:00 AM on the day of departure. Now, let’s talk about gear. The jungle can be quite muddy.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I was wondering about that. Do we need to bring anything specific?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: We provide raincoats, but it's essential that everyone brings their own waterproof boots. Sneakers just won't cut it in the rainforest.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: Okay, waterproof boots. I'll make sure we buy some this weekend. Anything else?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Just a reminder about insurance. We require all participants to have a comprehensive policy. Crucially, it must include medical coverage for emergency evacuations.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: That makes sense. We already have travel insurance, but I’ll double-check the medical clauses.

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Great. Lastly, to secure the booking, we require a deposit of $250 per person. Since there are four of you, that would be a total of $1,000.

transcript.speaker: Mark
transcript.text: I can pay that by credit card now if that's easiest?

transcript.speaker: Sarah
transcript.text: Certainly. If you could just give me the card number...

questions.explanation: Khách hàng tự giới thiệu tên là Mark Henderson ở đầu đoạn hội thoại.
Người nói ban đầu đưa ra số cũ (892) sau đó đính chính lại là 0412 555 982.
Ngày 14 tháng 7 đã hết chỗ, khách hàng đồng ý chuyển sang ngày 18 tháng 7 (18th July).
Nhân viên thông báo chuyến tham quan kéo dài 5 ngày.
Khách hàng nói có 4 người (vợ chồng và 2 con).
Vợ của khách hàng là người ăn chay (vegetarian).

questions.explanation: Khách hàng xác nhận họ sẽ ở khách sạn Central Hotel và đây là điểm đón.
Nhân viên nhấn mạnh khách hàng phải tự mang theo giày ủng chống thấm nước (waterproof boots).
